name: Atlassian MCP
description: Dynamically discovers and exposes the tools of the official Atlassian MCP Server (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket, Compass, Loom, Teamwork Graph). Authentication is either per-user OAuth 2.1 (PKCE, dynamic client registration) or a headless API token / service-account key configured by the admin. Tools are discovered on demand (admin Connect + Refresh) and execute as the calling user.
author: AI Playground

mcpUrl.title: MCP Server URL
mcpUrl.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of the Atlassian MCP Server. Default: https://mcp.atlassian.com/v2/mcp

exposeAllTools.title: Expose all tools (?tools=all)
exposeAllTools.description: By default Atlassian exposes a small set of primary tools plus discover/execute meta-tools. Enable to fetch the full flat tool list (recommended for this plugin so every tool is registered individually).

authMode.title: Authentication mode
authMode.description: oauth: each user connects with their own Atlassian account (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE). api_token: a single headless credential (personal API token or service-account key) is used for every call — required for Jira Service Management tools.

oauthClientId.title: OAuth Client ID
oauthClientId.description: Client ID obtained by dynamic client registration on https://auth.atlassian.com/VCeDsk8ZHncYF1g234fKtc4lNipbBhu3/dcr/register (the authorization server of the v2 MCP resource). Do NOT use an app from developer.atlassian.com (3LO apps are not accepted by the MCP authorization server). Leave empty to let the plugin register a client automatically (in-memory: users must reconnect after a restart — persist the logged client_id here once known). An org admin must allowlist this playground's redirect URL under Atlassian Administration → Rovo → Rovo MCP server → Domain settings.

oauthClientSecret.title: OAuth Client Secret
oauthClientSecret.description: Only for confidential clients. Leave empty for public (PKCE-only) clients such as those obtained via dynamic registration.

oauthScope.title: OAuth Scopes
oauthScope.description: Space-separated scopes requested at authorization. Default covers Jira + Confluence read/write/search plus Rovo search. See https://mcp.atlassian.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/v2/mcp for the full list.
oauthScope.default: offline_access read:me read:jira:agent-interface write:jira:agent-interface search:jira:agent-interface read:confluence:agent-interface write:confluence:agent-interface search:confluence:agent-interface search:rovo:agent-interface

oauthAuthorizeUrl.title: OAuth Authorize URL
oauthAuthorizeUrl.description: Default: https://auth.atlassian.com/authorize (authorization server of https://mcp.atlassian.com/v2/mcp). The legacy https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/authorize issues tokens the v2 resource rejects.

apiTokenEmail.title: API token e-mail
apiTokenEmail.description: Atlassian account e-mail paired with a personal API token (Basic auth). Leave empty when using a service-account API key (Bearer). Falls back to env ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN_EMAIL.

apiToken.title: API token / service-account key
apiToken.description: Personal API token (with e-mail above) or service-account API key. Falls back to env ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN. An org admin must enable API-token auth for the MCP server.

defaultCloudId.title: Default cloudId / site URL
defaultCloudId.description: Atlassian site to target by default, e.g. https://yoursite.atlassian.net (or the cloudId UUID). Injected automatically into tools that accept a cloudId when the LLM omits it — avoids an extra discovery call.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time for a single MCP call.
